old_problem: Procedure combines Type 26 probe metadata with Type 3 chassis fields. Prior review left field ownership pending although DMTF defines it. DeepSeek provides no population, raw encoding, sentinel, scale, range or precision evidence and could misrepresent static metadata as live voltage validation.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict. DMTF maps Description, Location/Status, Maximum/Minimum, Resolution, Tolerance, Accuracy, OEM-defined and Nominal Value to Type 26, while the listed chassis fields map to Type 3. Both branches remain mandatory. Raw encodings, unknown sentinels, scaling, probe population and engineering relationships are validated against Project matrices. This proves firmware metadata only; electrical accuracy needs separate instrumentation coverage.
decision_basis: XLSX row 1938, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record and ED-01 through ED-30 were read; the actual next queue row was directly opened as Functionality 1939 / Wistron-BIOS-00481-V002 / 39a0ec2b8e1d36dc.
DMTF assigns the probe fields to Type 26 and chassis identity/status/security to Type 3, eliminating the mapping ambiguity while preserving every field.
Raw encoded values and standard unknown sentinels are retained alongside normalized units; unknown is not zero and cannot pass unless explicitly allowed for that probe.
Per-probe checks include unique description/location, expected status and coherent approved min/nominal/max, resolution, tolerance and accuracy metadata.
The testcase is metadata validation; it does not stimulate rails or compare against a calibrated voltmeter. No live-voltage PASS is claimed.
No dmidecode, SSH, reboot, log-clear, voltage-control, firmware, SMBIOS or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: SMBIOS Type 26 voltage-probe metadata and Type 3 companion persistence
test_case.purpose: Verify the complete expected Type 26 voltage-probe population, raw/normalized metadata and the listed Type 3 chassis fields against exact matrices before and after one approved warm reboot, without claiming live electrical accuracy.
required_package: Exact target/BIOS/SMBIOS identity and Type 26 matrix with probe count, description, location, status, raw encodings, unit scale, sentinel policy, min/max/nominal/resolution/tolerance/accuracy and OEM value
Validated dmidecode and complete Type 26/3 parser preserving raw encodings, handles, multiplicity, stderr/status and protected evidence
Secure access, approved OS warm reboot/window/Boot ID timeout and independent recovery
Preserved platform logs and explicit statement that live voltage metrology is separate
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY COLLECTION AROUND ONE APPROVED REBOOT; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Bind target identity and preserve logs. Securely collect complete `dmidecode --type 26` and `--type 3` output/status without grep. For each Type 26 handle retain raw encoding, decode sentinel/scale, validate unique description/location, status, min/nominal/max and precision metadata against the probe matrix; separately validate Type 3. After one approved OS warm reboot with same-target Boot ID/OS Ready proof, repeat and semantic-diff. Do not clear logs, alter voltage/fan/firmware/SMBIOS state, expose secrets, auto-retry or claim live rail accuracy.
test_case.expected_result: Every expected Type 26 probe is present exactly as allowed with correct description, location/status, sentinel/scaled min/max/nominal, resolution, tolerance, accuracy and OEM metadata; no unapproved missing/duplicate probe or incoherent relationship occurs. Type 3 fields are correct. Both sets remain stable after OS Ready.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete successful pre/post Type 26/3 evidence, exact population/raw/decoded values and all relationship/chassis checks, approved Boot ID-changing reboot and OS Ready. FAIL on missing/duplicate probe, wrong status/location/value/scale/sentinel, incoherent approved range/precision, companion mismatch or reboot/health failure. NOT READY covers missing matrices/access/recovery. Header-only output or live-voltage claims cannot PASS; end user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Read-only metadata collection only; never alter voltage controls, thresholds, BIOS, SMBIOS, firmware or cooling.
Preserve complete raw encodings/logs and protect identity/OEM values; never clear logs or suppress errors.
Use secure verified access and approved reboot/recovery; no plaintext secret or disabled host verification.
Stop on wrong target, parser ambiguity, thermal/power anomaly or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant, target/BIOS/SMBIOS/dmidecode/parser identity and Type 26 plus Type 3 matrices
Complete pre/post Type 26/3 raw output/status and hashes
Per-probe handle, identity/location/status, raw/sentinel/normalized values and range/precision evaluation
Approved reboot timeline, Boot IDs, same-target OS Ready and preserved logs/health
No-live-metrology-claim/no-clear/no-write/no-retry audit, workload restore and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On reboot failure preserve first evidence and follow only approved console/BMC recovery. On missing/invalid probe metadata, preserve full SMBIOS and firmware identity, make no voltage/BIOS/SMBIOS change and escalate to BIOS/platform owner. Do not auto-reboot or adjust a rail to force metadata alignment.
